extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The UnitedHealthcare plan available in Orange County has a $10 monthly premium, a $15 drug deductible and a $5900 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed a Medicare Advantage plan with the customer, who prioritized the lowest premium. The agent scheduled a follow-up call for 6 hours later to review specific plans.
composition.coaching_note: Priya asked the customer to sign the Scope of Appointment while on the line, but then scheduled a follow-up call 6 hours later to review plans. Consider having the customer sign the SOA before scheduling the follow-up call to ensure timely completion.
